name: Moyubi Hime
source:
One day the protagonist notices a girl the size of a finger standing on his desk and decides to play a prank. As the tip of the cotton swab was twisted and pushed into Lina's secret place, Lina was helplessly swallowed up in a whirlwind of pleasure.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/242105/]Getchu[/url]]
